canonical.title: Weekend in Nice: JAN Dinner & Côte d'Azur

sources.title: Restaurant JAN — Official Site
sources.claim: Classique €165, Signature €195; 20 seats one sitting; MARIA visit included; deposit required

sources.title: JAN — MICHELIN Guide 2026
sources.claim: JAN holds 1 Michelin star in the 2026 MICHELIN Guide France

sources.title: Restaurant JAN Nice Review — Provence Lovers
sources.claim: 7-course format; biltong, bobotie, mullet ceviche; 120+ wine references; near Port Lympia

sources.title: JAN — TripAdvisor Reviews
sources.claim: 4.7/5 · 1,752 reviews · #46 of 2,155 in Nice; dinner runs 3–3.5 hours

sources.title: JAN Nice — Restaurant Guru
sources.claim: Google 4.8/5 · 1,132 reviews; 12 Rue Lascaris; +33 4 97 19 32 23

sources.title: JAN — Gault&Millau
sources.claim: 15/20 Remarkable; uncompromising imagination; respect for the product

sources.title: JAN Restaurant — SeeNice
sources.claim: Dinner Tue–Sat 19:00–22:00; lunch Fri–Sat 12:00–14:00; closed Sun & Mon

sources.title: MARIA cheese room — Chris von Ulmenstein
sources.claim: MARIA: 91 plates, portrait paintings, Paris Métro chandelier, South African gin bar

sources.title: Jan Hendrik van der Westhuizen — Ker & Downey
sources.claim: First South African chef with a Michelin star in France; grew up in Mpumalanga

sources.title: Cours Saleya Markets — Nice and Beyond
sources.claim: Flower/produce market Tue–Sat 06:00–17:00; summer evening artisan market from mid-May

sources.title: Vieux Nice Old Town — Nice and Beyond
sources.claim: Self-guided walk 2–3 hours; Place Rossetti, Cathédrale Sainte-Réparate, Palais Lascaris

sources.title: Castle Hill Nice — Nice and Beyond
sources.claim: Free elevator 10:00–17:25; 360° views over Baie des Anges; unreliable hours

sources.title: Chez Pipo — Official Site
sources.claim: Iconic socca; port district, 13 rue Bavastro

sources.title: TER Coastal Train — Best of Nice Blog
sources.claim: Every ~15 min until 22:00; Villefranche €2.10/5 min, Monaco €4.40/20 min, Cannes €7.90/40 min

sources.title: Bus to Èze Village — Best of Nice Blog
sources.claim: Buses #82/#602 from Vauban station ~30 min; avoid #600 (goes to Èze-sur-Mer not village)

sources.title: Èze + Monaco Day Trip — French Riviera Traveller
sources.claim: Morning Èze beats cruise buses; Monaco in afternoon after cruise passengers re-board

sources.title: Day Trips from Nice — Best of Nice Blog
sources.claim: Villefranche 5–15 min TER; Cap Ferrat bus #15; recommended as half or full day

sources.title: Villa Ephrussi from Nice — In Between Pictures
sources.claim: Bus #15 from Nice directly to Passable/Rothschild stop at Villa entrance

sources.title: Monaco Grand Prix 2026 — Formula 1
sources.claim: GP qualifying Saturday June 6, race Sunday June 7 2026 — all Monaco transport jammed

sources.title: Bus #600 Nice–Monaco–Menton — Monaco Tribune
sources.claim: Bus #600 every 15 min weekdays; merges old #100/#607/#608 as of April 2024

sources.title: Nice Transit Prices 2026
sources.claim: Single €1.70 · 10-trip €15 · 24h pass €7 · 7-day €20; Lignes d'Azur

sources.title: Côte d'Azur June Weather — Provence Lovers
sources.claim: June: 24–27 °C days, 17 °C nights, 23 °C sea, ~12 h sunshine, 20–30 mm rain over 4 days

sources.title: JAN Organic Wines — JAN Official
sources.claim: JAN white (Chenin Blanc/Roussanne/Verdelho) and red (Shiraz/Mourvèdre/Grenache) from Org de Rac in the Swartland

sources.title: Where to Stay in Nice — Go Ask a Local
sources.claim: Vieux Nice from ~$160/night; Carré d'Or for quieter boutique hotels; Promenade ~$143 average
